method: The day runs 18:00-18:00 New York. Levels are the prior day's range and value area, plus Asia+London (18:00-09:30). The read is graded at 18:00 against the move from the read price.
sim_note: bias = take the side at the read price, stop at the nearest level the other way, target the next level along. plan = wait for a trigger to be accepted, then trade it from there. Both are 1 coin, no costs.

reads.note: Trading -1.39% below yesterday's value area. Acceptance below 85,662 keeps sellers in control; a reclaim of it says the flush was absorbed.
